# Security

Report sensitive issues through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Dadarnie/kumo/security/advisories/new).
If it is unavailable, contact the maintainer before posting details publicly.

Include the version or commit, Windows version, impact and a minimal
reproduction. Remove credentials, personal paths and transcript contents.

Authentication, bounded inputs, session ownership, concurrent-edit protection
and terminal fallback must remain intact in relay, integration and file changes.
